provenance.question: does a label-free confidence score rank correspondence errors, and is the inverse-OT cost margin a better ranker than the supervised arm's softmax margin?
provenance.scores: cost_margin = c_(2nd) - c_(1st) per source row; softmax_margin = P_ii - max_{j!=i} P_ij with P = softmax(-c/tau), tau=0.003 (the value selected on n=6890 validation pairs)
provenance.thetas: relaxed_lp (simplex-only regret master) and row_softmax (one-sided CE, 600 Adam steps) -- the same 13 standardised descriptors, fitted on the same training pair (0,13)
provenance.metric: risk-coverage: rank by confidence, keep the top q fraction, report miss@5% and mean geodesic error among them; AUROC of the >5% error indicator
provenance.no_labels: neither confidence score uses the ground-truth correspondence; the truth is used only to score the ranking
provenance.memory: cost + geodesic matrix + POT plan are three n x n float64 arrays; at n=4000 that is ~384 MB
